standard_prerequisites.name: Algebraicity of Hilbert stacks
standard_prerequisites.use: Algebraicity of the coproduct of H_d.

standard_prerequisites.name: LCI substack and its properties
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-lci-locus-stack-in-groupoids, lemma-limit-preserving, lemma-lci-formally-smooth, lemma-lci-surjective (same chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: The lci locus is algebraic, and limit-preserving/formally-smooth/surjective on objects.

standard_prerequisites.name: Property implication and lifting
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfer object-level properties to morphism-level and conclude smoothness.

core_obligations: Assemble the smooth cover V -> coproduct H_{d,lci} -> Y and claim the composite is smooth surjective.
Transfer the three object-level properties through the two compositions (V over the Hilbert stack; the Hilbert stack over Y), using the where-locus and composition lemmas.
Convert object-level properties to morphism-level properties via the implication principle and conclude smoothness by the infinitesimal lifting criterion.
proof_roadmap: Build the cover from Hilbert stacks of the lci locus, verify the three properties through the two compositions step by step, and close with the implication principle plus infinitesimal lifting.
difficulty_reason: Long orchestration proof: the strategy (Hilbert stack of the lci locus as cover) is the content, and the three-property transfer is a systematic multi-step composition.
